title: Cookie Notice
primary_text: We use cookies for analytics (Google Analytics) and to personalize the ads shown on blog posts (Google AdSense). They only load if you accept. If you don't, the site works the same and any ads are non-personalized.
reason1: To remember your preferences: Such as language and theme settings.
reason2: To personalize your experience: Offering content and advertisements that are more relevant to you.
reason3: For analytics: Collecting data on how you use our site to improve our service.
advice: You can change your choice at any time:
